name: NOVATECH
recent: NOVATECH 提议设立最高占已发行股本 30% 的员工与董事股份发行计划（SIS），并已于 10 月 23 日向 Bursa Securities 提交额外上市申请。公司将于 11 月 27 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会，同时已发布 2026 年报。
notable: 提议设立最高占已发行股本 30% 的股份发行计划（SIS），供合格董事与员工认购。
已于 2026 年 10 月 23 日向 Bursa Securities 提交 SIS 的额外上市申请。
将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会。
risks: 股份发行计划（SIS）最高可发行相当于已发行股本 30% 的新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。

recent_en: NOVATECH has proposed a share issuance scheme (SIS) of up to 30% of its issued share capital for eligible directors and employees, with the additional listing application submitted to Bursa Securities on 23 October.
notable_en: Proposed establishment of a share issuance scheme (SIS) of up to 30% of issued share capital for eligible directors and employees.
Additional listing application for the SIS was submitted to Bursa Securities on 23 October 2026.
26th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 27 November 2026.
risks_en: The SIS may issue new shares of up to 30% of issued share capital, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
